<think>
The user wants me to look at their hotel and resort bookings on Cheskepdia (port 3012). The current page shows a connection error for localhost:3005. I need to navigate to Cheskepdia at localhost:3012. There's no Cheskepdia bookmark visible in the toolbar, so I'll type the URL directly in the address bar. Let me click the address bar first and enter the URL.
</think>

I'll start by navigating to Cheskepdia. Let me click the address bar and enter the correct URL.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[515, 119]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The page shows "Unable to connect" for localhost:3005. This might mean the services aren't running. Let me check if Cheskepdia (port 3012) is up. First let me try navigating there. But all three tabs show "Problem loading page", which suggests the local servers may not be running at all. Let me check via bash.
</think>

Let me first check whether the local web services are actually running, since the current tab shows a connection error.

<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>
for p in 3001 3002 3003 3004 3005 3006 3007 3008 3009 3010 3011 3012 3013 3014 3015 3016 3017; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 3 http://localhost:$p/ 2>/dev/null); echo "$p -> $code"; done
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The bash tool didn't return output visibly. Let me try again — maybe the output will appear in the next turn. Actually, I see the screenshot but no tool response text for bash. Let me re-run it.

</think>

<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>
for p in 3001 3002 3003 3004 3005 3006 3007 3008 3009 3010 3011 3012 3013 3014 3015 3016 3017; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 3 http://localhost:$p/ 2>/dev/null); echo "$p -> $code"; done
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The bash tool output isn't showing. Let me try again — maybe the output was empty/not returned. Let me check the ports again with a simpler command.

Actually, looking at the screenshots, the bash tool results don't appear to be rendered in the screenshot. The user turn before showed "3001 -> 307" etc. which suggests the servers respond with 307 redirects (probably to login or main page). So the servers ARE running. Firefox just had trouble connecting at that moment.

Let me retry navigating in Firefox. First press Escape to dismiss the autocomplete dropdown, then type the URL for Cheskepdia port 3012.
</think>

The services are running (they return 307 redirects). Firefox just needs a reload. Let me navigate to Cheskepdia on port 3012.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
type
</parameter>
<parameter=text>
http://localhost:3012/
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The bash tool isn't returning output visibly. Let me just press Enter in the address bar to navigate.
</think>

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
key
</parameter>
<parameter=keys>
["return"]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The page seems to still show the old state. Let me take a screenshot to see the current state.
</think>

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[500, 624]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
It's now "Transferring data from localhost..." — good, it's loading. Let me wait and take a screenshot.

Note: the VPN indicator might be causing issues but curl worked. Let me wait.
</think>

The page is now loading ("Transferring data from localhost..."). Let me wait for it to finish.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
wait
</parameter>
<parameter=time>
2.0
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The tab title is now "Cheskepdia" and the URL shows an autologin param. It's still loading. Let me wait more.
</think>

The tab title changed to "Cheskepdia" with an autologin redirect. Let me wait for it to render fully.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
wait
</parameter>
<parameter=time>
3.0
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
Cheskepdia is loaded. Now I need to look at the bookings/trips. Let me click on "Trips" in the top navigation.
</think>

Cheskepdia has loaded. Now let me check my bookings by clicking "Trips".

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[872, 231]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The click on Trips didn't seem to navigate. Let me try clicking again more precisely on the "Trips" text.
</think>

The page didn't change. Let me click directly on the "Trips" link.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[870, 231]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The Trips page is loaded. There's an upcoming reservation: Sandals Montego Bay, Resort, Sep 20-27 2026, 1 guest, Montego Bay Jamaica, Confirmed. I need to see the price too — let me scroll down to see if there's more info including price. Also check "Past" tab for booking history pattern.

Let me scroll down first to see full details of this upcoming booking (price may be shown).
</think>

I can see my Trips page with an upcoming booking. Let me scroll down to see the full details including pricing.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
mouse_move
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[500, 555]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
I see one upcoming reservation. Let me check the "Past" tab to see historical bookings, which will reveal the pattern.
</think>

Let me check the "Past" tab for previous bookings.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[229, 443]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
The tab didn't switch. Let me click on the "Past" text more precisely.
</think>

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[231, 443]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
Now I see the Past tab with "Where you've been". There are two bookings visible: Sandals Royal Barbados (Resort in St. James, Aug 16-23, 2026) and The Greenwich Hotel (Hotel in Manhattan, May 2 - May 5, 2026). Let me scroll down to see more.
</think>

I can see past bookings now. Let me scroll down to see all of them.

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
mouse_move
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[500, 555]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<think>
I notice the "Past" tab shows only 2 bookings. But I should check if there are more by scrolling down further. Also, I need to see pricing info. Let me scroll down.
</think>

<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
mouse_move
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[500, 555]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
